trial_title: A Prospective Randomized Comparison Trial on the Use of Mifepristone With Sublingual or Buccal Misoprostol for Medical Abortions of Less Than 9 Weeks Gestation
brief_summary: The primary objective of this study is to compare the incidence of side effects of buccal and sublingual misoprostol when combined with mifepristone for medical abortions of less than 9 weeks gestation. The secondary outcome is to compare the complete abortion rate and induction-abortion interval between the two methods of administration of misoprostol.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old and does not have any reported chronic health conditions that would indicate poor general health.

eligibility_table.criterion: older than the age of legal consent (i.e. >18 years old)
requesting medical abortion and eligible for abortion
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is experiencing vaginal spotting and has elevated β-hCG levels, indicating a potential pregnancy, and is requesting a medical abortion.

eligibility_table.criterion: on Day 1 of the study (day of mifepristone administration) the duration of pregnancy not more than 63 days as confirmed by pelvic ultrasound examination
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a serum β-hCG level of 2100 mIU/mL and no gestational sac seen in the uterus, suggesting a possible ectopic pregnancy or non-viable pregnancy, which may exceed the 63-day limit.

eligibility_table.criterion: intrauterine pregnancy (intrauterine amniotic sac seen in US)
eligibility_table.justification: The ultrasound did not show an intrauterine pregnancy, as there is no gestational sac present.

eligibility_table.criterion: willing to use other than hormonal or intra-uterine contraception until the first menses after termination of pregnancy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of inconsistent contraceptive use, which suggests she may be willing to use non-hormonal methods post-abortion.

eligibility_table.criterion: if treatment fails she agrees to termination of pregnancy with the surgical method
eligibility_table.justification: While the patient may agree to surgical termination if medical treatment fails, there is no explicit indication of her willingness to do so.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient consented to undergo surgical termination of pregnancy if the medical abortion treatment fails?

eligibility_table.criterion: willing and able to participate after the study has been explained
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is seeking medical assistance and appears willing to participate in the study after it has been explained.
